description: Banks in the 27 EU countries that pay a cash bonus for opening a personal current account, read one by one from bank websites, with the amount, deadline and source page. With a country code: every bank paying a bonus there. Without it: the number of banks with a bonus in each country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of an EU country, e.g. "PL", "ES", "HU"
